subject.title: [Feature]: Channel Broker Phase 2A - broker conformance harness

question: Should OpenClaw restart Channel Broker as an approved public SDK/bundled plugin boundary, or should broker-specific harness work be deferred in favor of extending the existing channel contracts?
rationale: Current main lacks the requested broker surface, the candidate stack was rejected as too broad without prior design approval, and automation cannot choose the permanent plugin SDK, config, and security boundary.

options.title: Require smaller design first
options.body: Keep this issue open as the narrow tracker, but require a maintainer-approved design/API plan before any broker SDK, bundled plugin, config, or harness implementation resumes.

options.title: Use existing channel contracts
options.body: Close or defer broker-specific work and direct future fixes into `channel-outbound`, `channel-ingress`, and native channel adapter conformance instead.

options.title: Approve broker restart
options.body: Sponsor a new focused broker proposal that defines the public SDK, security, config, and migration boundary before implementation PRs are opened.

recommendation.title: Require smaller design first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the narrow tracker, but require a maintainer-approved design/API plan before any broker SDK, bundled plugin, config, or harness implementation resumes.

likelyOwner.reason: This account made the live close decision for the related broker stack and is the clearest owner for whether the design may restart.
